chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Jamīl, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who dies and leaves behind an enslaved son. He said: "His son should be purchased from his wealth, then freed, and he will inherit whatever remains."

key_terms.مِنْ مَالِهِ: from the deceased man’s estate or wealth

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man dies leaving behind an enslaved son?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning inheritance when a deceased man leaves behind a son who is enslaved. The son is to be purchased from the deceased’s estate and emancipated, after which he inherits what remains of the estate.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5733 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jameel who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who dies and leaves behind a son who is enslaved.
Imam (as) said: "His son should be purchased from his wealth, then freed, and he will inherit whatever remains."
